वैडूर्यपर्वत

VAIḌŪRYAPARVATA . A mountain which stands near Gokarṇatīrtha (holy place) in the country of śūrpāraka (kerala). agastya once built a hermitage on this mountain. If one bathes in the river narmadā, after having visited this Vaiḍūrya mountain one could attain the holy worlds. (M.B. Vana Parva, Chapter 33, Verse 13).
